create_stanford_dataset: create a StanfordArea5Dataset instance with config, transforms, and augmentation for 3D point cloud segmentation
run_pointcloud_evaluation: run full pointcloud evaluation on Stanford dataset predictions using test_pointcloud with a prediction directory
load_ply_pointcloud: load a PLY point cloud file returning coordinates, RGB features, and semantic labels via load_ply
load_torch_pointcloud: load a preprocessed Torch point cloud file returning coordinates, features, labels, and instances via load_data
augment_coords_to_feats: augment point cloud features by concatenating normalized centered coordinates to existing feature vectors
